overview_description.description: Squarespace is a website building and e-commerce platform that enables users to build brands and transact with their customers. The company's suite of products helps entrepreneurs, creatives, and professionals manage their projects and businesses through websites, domains, e-commerce, marketing tools, scheduling, and Unfold, tools for managing a social media presence. The firm provides a variety of add-on and independent solutions, including scheduling capabilities, email marketing, member sections for paid content, and design tools for social networking and video content.

about_short_description.short_description: Squarespace is a website building and hosting platform that helps users create websites without needing advanced technical skills.

product.name: Squarespace Websites
product.description: A hosted website-building platform with templates, drag-and-drop editing, responsive layouts, content management, security, and analytics for creating and managing websites without coding.

product.name: Squarespace Commerce
product.description: Ecommerce tools for creating online stores, listing products, processing orders and payments, managing inventory and shipping, and selling physical, digital, subscription, and service offerings.

product.name: Squarespace Domains
product.description: A domain registration and management service for searching, registering, transferring, and configuring domain names with DNS, forwarding, email forwarding, SSL, and WHOIS privacy features.

product.name: Acuity Scheduling
product.description: Online appointment and class scheduling software for booking management, calendar synchronization, intake forms, automated reminders, client records, payments, packages, subscriptions, and gift certificates.

product.name: Squarespace Payments
product.description: A payment-processing service that lets businesses accept multiple payment methods, manage transactions, support ecommerce checkout, and receive payouts through Squarespace.

product.name: Squarespace Invoicing
product.description: A business invoicing service for creating branded proposals, contracts, and invoices, sending them to clients, and tracking payments for products or services.
